section.title: Basic function
section.p: Smart Cruise Control detects a vehicle ahead and helps maintain the distance from the vehicle ahead and the set speed.

section.title: Overtake Acceleration Assist
section.p: When Smart Cruise Control judges you are attempting to overtake a vehicle in front, Smart Cruise Control helps with accelerating.

section.title: Based On Driving Style
section.p: Smart Cruise Control will operate based on the driver’s driving style, such as inter-vehicle distance, acceleration, reaction speed.

note.p: If an Emergency Stop Signal (ESS) is installed, certain SCC operations will differ from the owner’s manual. Make sure to understand the contents of the Emergency Stop (ES)

li.p: Always keep the front view camera and front radar in good condition to maintain optimal performance of Smart Cruise Control.
